note: also confirmed from the owner's Stremio profile (read only): Trakt access tokens carry expires_in 604800 s (7 days)

app: owner's Marquee app (new developer portal, no client secret)
activateWithCode: GET /activate/<code> answers 302 to /signin?callbackURL=/activate?user_code=<code> (the code rides along; pre-fill after sign-in not checked in a browser)
coreSignIn: TraktLoginView reached Done (245 s, the owner's approval time); record offered, acknowledged with setTrakt; account key = user.ids.uuid
differs: device code is 43 characters, not 64 hex
a revoked access token can keep working for minutes; its refresh token dies at once

limits: list {count 5, item_count 1000}, watchlist, favorites, search, collection, notes, saved_filters, streaming, recommendations

step: 4 movie scrobble (Sintel tt1727587, approved by the owner)
historyEntry: one, action scrobble, watched_at rounded to the minute
notRun: stop at 50 percent and a second stop within the window (409): beyond the one approved scrobble

step: 5 episode scrobble by TVDB id only (Game of Thrones S01E01, start and pause, approved)
searchTvdbEpisode: show.ids.imdb present; ids also carry a plex object

step: 6 history add and remove (ids nobody has; the owner's history untouched)

add.not_found_entries: echo what was sent, watched_at included

differs: adds answer an updated count besides added; if a re-sent play is counted there, added plus not_found no longer covers the batch
notRun: a real add by TVDB and IMDb ids (it would write to the owner's history)

headers: x-pagination-page, -limit, -page-count, -item-count on history, watched movies and shows, history/shows/<id>, playback
pagePastTheLast: 200 with []: the empty page ends the list
watchedPaged: /sync/watched/movies and /shows honor page and limit; without them they answer the first 100 (x-pagination-limit 100)
differs: /sync/watched is paginated now, default limit 100 (our calls always pass page and limit)

401AfterRevoke: yes (at once for one device, after a few minutes for the other)

result: the refresh token is dead at once (invalid_grant, session not found)

step: core rounds (a fresh library with Cinemeta, the refreshed record)

testTokens: all four revoked; refresh tokens answer session not found, access tokens 401
